versions.subject: feat: update shim rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventType: SetValue
    TargetObject|contains: '\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\AppCompatFlags\Custom\'
    TargetObject|endswith:
        # Note: add other application to increase coverage
        - '\csrss.exe'
        - '\dllhost.exe'
        - '\explorer.exe'
        - '\services.exe'
        - '\svchost.exe'
        - '\taskhostw.exe'
        - '\winlogon.exe'
condition: selection
